description.value: Lila Restaurant is a contemporary Indian dining room on Vancouver's Main Street, led by Chef Meeru Dhalwala with a strong commitment to sustainability and locally sourced BC ingredients. The menu spans vegan and gluten-free-friendly dishes alongside BC seafood, pasture-raised meats, and a hidden garden patio. Touring cyclists will find a genuine sit-down meal with broad dietary accommodation and online order-ahead for takeout.
